label: Baijiahao
terms_note: 百家号 creator account (personal or enterprise, real-name verified); API credentials (app_id, app_token) generated in the account's own 开发者 settings — BYO per tenant; content rules (原创, no promotional content on 普通 accounts — 商业推广 blocked unless the account holds the marketing qualification).

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (documented only inside the creator console).
auth: 1. Tenant's 百家号 account (real-name verified; enterprise accounts for brands) → 设置 › 开发者 / 接口权限 → app_id +
2. Token is long-lived until regenerated; store it in the account vault.

endpoints.call: POST …/article/publish` {app_id, app_token, title, content (HTML), feed_cat, cover_images, is_original, origin_url?}

reference.limits: - 百家号 platform rules: originality, no promotional / marketing text on standard accounts, category (feed_cat) must match the account's registered field; daily publish quotas depend on the account level.

fields.name: app_id
fields.help: 作者帐号ID (app_id) shown when you enable 开发者 service in the 百家号 creator console (开通开发者服务，获取app_token及app_id).

fields.name: app_token
fields.help: 授权密钥 (app_token) from the same 开发者 settings; sent in the request body of every call. Reset it at once if it leaks.

adapter.terms: 百家号开发者文档 (https://baijiahao.baidu.com/docs/#/normalcomplex/developer/serviceIntroduction): the author enables developer service, receives app_id + app_token, and each call POSTs them with the call's fields to https://baijiahao.baidu.com/builderinner/open/resource/...; answers {errno (0 = 成功), errmsg, data}; error codes at https://baijiahao.baidu.com/docs/#/normalcomplex/developer/errorCode. Content follows 百家号 review rules and the account's daily posting quota.

me.note: No self-profile call is documented, so the credentials are verified with query/articleListall (page_size 1): errno 0 answers {page, items{article_id: {article_id, nid, title, type, status, collection, article_url, updated_at}}}; errno 60001001 means 授权校验失败.

read_comments.note: query/articleCommentList (article_id, page_no, page_size ≤ 20): comments on one article (post_id = the article_id from the 百家号 console or article list), each {reply_id, thread_id, uname, avatar, content, create_time (epoch s), like_count, reply_count, favor, is_fans, reply_to_uname?}; data.page.has_next tells whether another page exists. Replies to one comment are at query/articleCommentReplyList (https://baijiahao.baidu.com/docs/#/normalcomplex/developer/getCommentResponse).

delete.note: article/withdraw (撤回内容) takes the published article's NID as article_id: the article stops being shown ('撤回后的文章将不再展示'); personalised-recommended articles cannot be withdrawn. Permanent deletion (article/delete, https://baijiahao.baidu.com/docs/#/normalcomplex/developer/delete) only applies to drafts of 图文/横版视频 and to published 小视频, so it is not what this verb maps to.

analytics_post.note: query/articleStatistics (article_id): cumulative recommend_count, view_count (阅读/播放量), comment_count, share_count, collect_count and likes_count since publication (-1 = 获取失败); no per-day series. The runtime cannot compose a nested metrics object or echo the post_id argument, so counts are top-level fields (all of data stays in raw).

not_offered.publish_text: article/publish (https://baijiahao.baidu.com/docs/#/normalcomplex/developer/publishPT) requires a title of 5-40 characters and a unique origin_url ('相同URL的文章会被认为是同一篇文章，禁止提交') besides the rich-text content; the vocabulary's publish_text carries only text, so neither required field can be supplied.
not_offered.publish_image: There is no image post: 发布图片 (image/pushPic, https://baijiahao.baidu.com/docs/#/normalcomplex/developer/pushPic) submits images with per-image id, title, objurl, fromurl and edit_time to Baidu 图片搜索 (Image Search) for institutional original authors, not to the account's feed; image posts otherwise go through article/publish, which needs a title and origin_url.
not_offered.reply_comment: No comment-reply call is documented: the 评论管理 group has only read calls (commentAuthorListall, articleCommentStatistics, articleCommentList, articleCommentReplyList; https://baijiahao.baidu.com/docs/#/normalcomplex/developer/getAuthorCommentList).
not_offered.read_mentions: No mention or @-notification call is documented in the developer docs (https://baijiahao.baidu.com/docs/#/normalcomplex/developer/serviceIntroduction lists 内容发布, 内容管理, 文章查询, 评论管理, 数据查询, 用户管理).

live_check.notes: requires app_id, app_token; started, listed tools and answered a clean auth_error naming the variables
